title: Improving Zero-Noise Extrapolation via Physically Bounded Models
summary: Zero-noise extrapolation (ZNE) mitigates errors in near-term quantum devices by extrapolating measurements obtained at amplified noise levels to estimate noise-free expectation values. In practice, commonly used extrapolation models are fitted without enforcing physical constraints, which can yield predictions outside the valid range of quantum observables. In this work, we introduce physically bounded variants of polynomial, exponential, and polynomial--exponential extrapolation models by explicitly parameterizing the zero-noise estimate and constraining it during optimization.
